The '''2026 Retro League''' is the fifth season of the [[Retro League]], billed as the "5th Annual SWCCG Retro League". [[Steve Sanders]] is the organizer and tournament director. Games are played on [[GEMP]], and entry is a flat \$10 fee.<ref name="t86346" />

== Changes ==
* A Prelude event for new and returning players opened the season. The fee was waived for it.<ref name="t86346" />
* The season has four events, with no Event 5. Event 4 is [[Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)]], which adds Defensive Shields to [[Classic (no v-cards)]].<ref name="t86346" />

== Standings after Event 1 ==
The top ten were Ian Monteith (22), Brad Kippel (18), and eight players tied on 16: Bill Bisco, Matthew Ford, Garrett Larson, Jeremy Christoffel, Joe Horbey, Will Tarbox, [[Charles Hickey|Charlie Hickey]] and [[Matt Fendt|Matthew Fendt]].<ref name="pc2026e1" />
